parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights for my company, deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off each flight before it leaves. My legal responsibility is choosing the drone and the way it flies, and I am the licensed person responsible for each flight who can also call it off. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I need the service to help me find out which of my drones could get to where a job starts.
